sources.title: Q Mini Fix | 16" 300 BLK Rifle - product page (Live Q Or Die / Q, LLC)

weapons.name: Fix .300BLK 16"
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer product page for the 16 in .300 BLK barrel, feature callout: '1:5 TWIST'. 1 turn in 5 in = 127.0 mm. Model-identity caveat: the 16 in .300 BLK rifle in Q's Fix bolt-action line is catalogued as the Mini Fix (page title 'Q Mini Fix | 16" 300 BLK Rifle'); Q's 'The Fix' proper is catalogued only in .308 Win (16 in, 1:10 twist) and 6.5 Creedmoor (16/22 in, 1:7 twist), plus 8.6 BLK (1:3 twist) - see https://www.liveqordie.com/the-fix/. Q's own 'THE FIX & mini FIX BY Q' manual gives the same rate for the .300 BLK barrel (table 'CALIBER ... 300 BLK / TWIST RATE 1:5'). The corpus lead (178 mm = 1:7) is not supported by Q. Groove count is not stated.
